page.overview:
Who is Nydas Okiro?

is a human sorcerer/bard who was the Guildmaster of the Golden Scythe in the city of Avalir. He is played by Lou Wilson.

Nydas was 5'10" and stocky. His eyes were hazel flecked with actual gold, and he had a long scar over his right eye and three X tattoos over his left eye. His beard ended with a golden ring, and he had shoulder-length dreadlocks cuffed with gold, over which he wore a floppy cap in the style of a Renaissance merchant. He wore a cape over a red coat with a golden pin with the signature of the Golden Scythe.

Nydas was flamboyant, jovial, and theatrical.

A former pirate, Nydas rose to the position of Guildmaster of the Golden Scythe guild and founded the Sorcerer's University in Avalir.
